rfp_contact.quote: You may submit questions to tender@bettercotton.org - with reference “RFP  2026-9-DE-MIDDLEWARE” until 20th September 2026, noting that the final submission deadline for bids is the 27th September 2026.

submission_method.quote: All applications must be submitted via this form.

scope_of_deliverables.value: The RFP seeks a Tier 1 middleware / iPaaS solution (with optional Tier 2 and low-code platform tracks) providing governed integration backbone, API management, data transformation, workflow orchestration, messaging, monitoring, and external partner integration, plus data governance, partner onboarding, operations, security, and implementation/transition services.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Provide one consolidated response document and one completed requirements response matrix.
value: Provide one consolidated response document and one completed requirements response matrix.

evaluation_criteria.quote:
Proposals will be evaluated based on the following criteria: 
Technical Evaluation Criteria 
• 
Demonstrated understanding of this RFP 
• 
Quality and clarity of the proposed approach and methodology 
• 
Resource requirements, migration approach, and risk 
• 
Validate RFP response claims through scripted scenarios, architecture review, security review, data model discussion, and operating model review.   
• 
Feasibility of the proposed activity plan and timeline, and appropriateness of time 
allocated to delivering each task 
• 
Relevant professional experience of the proposed vendor and implementation team 
• 
Quality and relevance of the sample work, references, and case studies submitted 

Financial Evaluation Criteria 
• 
Quality and clarity of budget provided, and level of detail included 
• 
Alignment of the budget to the activity timeline detailed in the technical proposal 
• 
Assess license/subscription model, implementation cost, support costs, and overall 
value   
• 
Adherence to the available budget

pricing_structure.quote: Provide pricing in the commercial response template, including software/subscription, implementation services, support, training, and optional modules.
pricing_structure.value: Pricing must be provided in the commercial response template (Section 10), covering software/subscription, implementation services, support, training, and optional modules. The commercial proposal is a separate response component (Section 5) from the technical proposal, and pricing is submitted separately from the technical response.

data_security_requirements.quote: Security: Credential/secrets management, encryption in transit, least-privilege administration, role-based controls, auditability, and security protocol disclosure.

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: 28 September to 16 October 2026 Proposal evaluation, shortlisting, and vendor Proof of Concept / demonstration sessions (Section 8).
